note: Gantt and Baseline Manager cleanup. The Baseline Manager now lists only live projects (deleted, archived and completed projects are hidden) and has a search box to jump to a project by ID or name. On the Gantt, the dashed float bar no longer appears on tasks that have no dependency links at all — those tasks were inheriting the project end date as their late finish and showing a misleading float bar stretching to project finish. Float now shows only for tasks wired into the schedule (with a predecessor or successor), where it actually means something.
